descriptor.retrieval_description: Fabric-covered semi-rigid case object with a textured, dry, fabric-wrapped lateral surface and rounded geometry. The intended contact region has gently curved, continuous vertical sidewalls interrupted only by a horizontal zipper seam.

descriptor.local_geometry: Gently curved, broad continuous area featuring a horizontal zipper seam running around the perimeter
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: Clearly visible on the lateral sides
